content: Time is the wisest counselor of all, for it reveals the truth of all hidden things.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Chronos gar panton sophotatos — Thales of Miletus (Seven Sages)
explanation: Lies, PR campaigns, and elaborate deceptions can dazzle an audience for a day or a year. But time is completely uncorrupted by bribes: it slowly erodes the plaster of hypocrisy until the bare stone beneath is exposed to the sunlight. Let time do its work.
practicalInsight: Do not rush to defend yourself against every petty misrepresentation today. Live with quiet integrity and let time vindicate you.
reflectionPrompt: What situation are you frantically trying to force into the open that simply needs the patient illumination of time?
